title: Domain of a Semicircle Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The graph of y=sqrt(4-x^2) is the upper half of a circle of radius 2 centered at the origin. Find its natural domain algebraically.

steps.title: Impose the Radicand Condition
steps.explanation: An even square root requires its contents to be nonnegative.
steps.why: sqrt(u) is real only for u >= 0.

steps.title: Rearrange the Inequality
steps.explanation: Moving x^2 to the other side of 4-x^2 >= 0 gives x^2 <= 4.
steps.why: Adding x^2 to both sides preserves the inequality.

steps.title: Convert to an Absolute-Value Bound
steps.explanation: The inequality x^2 <= 4 holds exactly when the distance of x from 0 is at most 2.
steps.why: For real x, x^2 <= a^2 is equivalent to |x| <= a.

steps.title: Write the Interval
steps.explanation: Both endpoints satisfy 4-x^2=0, and sqrt(0)=0 is valid, so they are included.
steps.why: Closed brackets record that the boundary inputs are allowed.
